paragraphs: On Sunday evening, Mia wrote an email to her pen pal Nadia. She put a photo from the old town in the email. "Dear Nadia, Here is a photo from our trip with the Explorers. We went to the old town on Saturday morning with Teacher Kim. It shows a small shop with tables outside. The shop has free wifi, and you can see the sign at the door. Can you find three people in the photo? I will tell you about each one.

Person one is a woman at a table. She has long black hair, and she wears a blue dress. A gold ring is on her finger. She holds a cup of tea in one hand. In the other hand, she has a small book. She looks happy because the sun is warm. Her bag is on the chair next to her.

Person two is a man on a chair. He wears a green shirt and black trousers. His belt is brown, and his sunglasses are round. His eyes are closed, and his hands are on his knees. Leo says, "He looks lazy." I think that he is just tired after a very long walk. There is a small green tree behind him.

Person three is a small boy near the door. He has a yellow paper crown on his head. A woman at the shop gave it to him. His T-shirt is red, and his shorts are blue. He holds a big ice cream in both hands. He is about five years old. Everyone smiles when they see him. He looks like a little king!
Did you find all three? Which person do you like best? I took this photo because I liked the three people. Please write back soon and tell me. Your friend, Mia"
text.summary: Mia writes an email to her pen pal Nadia. She sends a photo from the old town and describes three people in it by their looks and their clothes.
